# One-off invocation source preparation

This first source-only slice prepares the retained admitted-range invocation for
the diagnostic reader. It establishes no live invocation, observer capture,
resource acceptance or additional LexLean control. The original
`memory.events.max=6325` failure remains unaccepted.

`invocation-preparation.mjs` exports only `main(argv)`, where the sole admitted
argument shape is `['complete-admitted-positive']`. Import is inert. The literal
null epoch rejects that argument before output creation, resource reads, process
launch or postguards. Other arguments reject earlier. There is no command-line
auto-run, configurable epoch, exported runner or environment override.

The original invocation is inert JSON, independently pinned to 12,797 bytes and
SHA-256 `3cc48e7aef25481a08f64bb9e2ea2f2b6b32a2e48109659b0322efd90d099b27`.
Do not execute that historical source. The test reconstructs the whole candidate
through uniquely matched literal edits: fixed positive mode, null epoch and
gate relocation, private extraction of the original body, and the small `main`
entry. All other bytes remain exact, including 50 inputs, 33-module selection,
tool pins, captures, verify call and eight postguards.

From this directory, with Node 26.4.0:

```sh
node --test --experimental-test-coverage test_invocation_preparation.mjs
node --check invocation-preparation.mjs
```

Five tests pass. Three missing-source RED tests preceded implementation; two
separate test-instrument failures and repairs are preserved in the results.
Representative changed obligations reject as text without executing mutants or
substituting a live epoch. A scoped Node loader hook supplies the exact checked
source while all candidate filesystem/process effects remain forbidden. A
one-load assertion prevents cached-import coverage from passing vacuously.

Candidate line coverage is **31.00%**, branch coverage **66.67%**; combined
test/source line coverage is **67.30%**. The retained live body and post-null
path are deliberately unreachable. These figures do **not** meet the generic
80% premerge requirement. This reviewed source checkpoint may be pushed for
continuity but is not merge-ready. Source fidelity does not waive runtime
coverage, and a live epoch must not be substituted merely to cover those paths.

Next connect minimal guest configuration/launch and owned observer-exit custody
under independent design and source review. Consumed-ACK timeout/abort races,
exact namespace/root linkage, complete absolute-zero admission, fresh paths,
shared-filesystem behavior, observer overhead and actual resource review remain
unresolved. Do not run the old invocation or retry the proof unchanged. The nine
